name: Reference column
description: Two technical columns of solutions.csv, adopts and specializes, hold @library/solution_id, and the configuration's [adopts.<library>] names the library's repository; the registry keeps adopted rows apart, and the rule S53 resolves them.
advantages: One column on the records every repository already has, the same reference form as uses_solution_ids, and every reader of the registry sees only the repository's own solutions. Selected because: the only implementation built; its cases pin the behaviour any rival must keep
disadvantages: The library's repository must be reachable where the check runs.

name: Copied records
description: The application copies the library's solution records and edits them, with a note of where each came from.
advantages: Nothing to resolve and the application reads without the library.
disadvantages: The copies restate the library's job and drift from it.
